qargi hands one-off development tasks to agents and takes the work back as patches you can review. This is the operational layer: what to type, in what order.

## Where to start

- New to qargi: [your first project](/first-project/).
- Looking for a verb or an option: the [command reference](/reference/), for example [project init](/reference/set-up/#project-init).
- What changed in a version: the [releases](/releases/).

## The idea in four steps

1. Describe the project once with `qargi project template acme`.
2. Name the members who work on it.
3. Give a member a task and an executable check.
4. Review the patches it returns, then apply them yourself.
